about: The platform canary's clock and pager (d3 §J2), read through contract/src/canary.ts: the doors' Cron Trigger dispatches the canary's workflow every ten minutes with the dispatch token, and pages the founder directly when that dispatch fails; the workflow's alarm (platform/deploy/alarm.ts) pages through the same pager. Every name here is a live one, kept once.

dispatch.why: The workflow the clock starts, on this repository's main, by GitHub's workflow_dispatch (POST /repos/{repository}/actions/workflows/{workflow}/dispatches, which a fine-grained token with Actions write on the one repository may call). The token is the founder's to mint and an optional secret of the doors: without it the clock dispatches nothing.

pager.why: Pushover's messages API, the founder's pager since GitHub's issue email alone left an outage unseen for 18 hours (2026-04-22). The two keys are the ones uptime-canary.yml pages with, and pushover-test.yml proved them (2026-09-24).
